name: JAK-12 Automatic Shotgun
description_html:
Updated to and only tested on 3.8.0, should work on 3.8.3

未经允许请勿搬运到其他社区！

Please do not re-upload this mod without permission!

JAK-12 is an automatic shotgun created by Infinity Ward on the basis of AA-12 from the game Call of Duty.

The mod only includes the basic configuration and an 8-rd magazine.

Models and textures came from Call of Duty by Infinity Ward.

Installion:

Just like other mods. Unzip and drop Mass_JAK12 folder into “[Your EFT Directory]/user/mods”.

You should be able to find it and its parts in Mechanic’s shop and on the flea market.

Feel free to drop your error into the comments.

Known Issue:

Some animations look a little weird.

Credits:

Infinity Ward — Models, Textures, Sounds, Animations;

John_Titor - converting orginal textures into EFT format;

Miraki(来自二次元的公主殿下) - baking animations from COD armature to EFT weapon armature;

Me — porting everything into tarkov, such as: building unity assets, tweaking animations, creating code and many more things.

For those who use this with MPT/fika, if you have bundle loading issue (e.g. white texture or doge), please manually distribute bundle files by copy /user/mods/[this mod name]/[this mod name]/bundles folder and merge it with the same-name folder under /user/cache/. This method apply to all my mods.
